tac_giyme.title: The morning after the coronation
tac_giyme.text: Every power center is watching the new king's first move. The waiting room is full. Whom you receive first will tell everyone who matters to you.

choices.label: Receive Arden first
choices.text: Arden bowed and left pleased. Vale checked his watch in the waiting room.

choices.label: Receive Vale first
choices.text: Vale left you a thick file: 'Who is who, Your Majesty.' Arden took note.

choices.label: See no one; greet the people
choices.text: You waved from the balcony. The crowd applauded; those in the waiting room did not.

ignore.text: You spent your first day in the waiting room.

ilk_butce.title: The first budget signature
ilk_butce.text: Prime Minister Veyra placed the first budget on your desk. One line was left blank: who gets the extra revenue?

choices.label: The army
choices.text: Goblets were raised in the barracks. Veyra quietly took note.

choices.label: The people
choices.text: Bread prices fell a little. For the first time, the people spoke your name with affection.

choices.label: The Palace treasury
choices.text: Your personal coffers filled. Veyra will not forget this line.

ignore.text: The budget passed on Veyra's recommendation.

gida_protestosu.title: Food prices spark protests
gida_protestosu.text: Bakery queues are growing in the capital. Police reports say things are 'under control,' but some units are said to be reluctant.

choices.label: Send troops and police
choices.text: The squares were cleared. General Arden will not forget this.

choices.label: Freeze prices by decree
choices.text: The queues outside bakeries thinned, but the budget and the market can barely breathe.

choices.label: Look the other way
choices.text: The protests grew for another week.

ignore.text: The protests were left to their own devices, and grew.

gazeteci_ihale.title: A reporter probes a secret tender
gazeteci_ihale.text: Leyla Sarn keeps finding the same company's name in state tenders: Sarne Holding.

fact.text: Secret tender file granted to Sarne

choices.label: Warn Sarne
choices.text: Sarne was grateful. Now you owe him a favor, not the other way around.

choices.label: Silence the reporter
choices.text: Leyla stopped writing. A frightened reporter does not forget.

choices.label: Let it run
choices.text: The file reached the press. Sarne weakened, and you look honest.

general_atamalari.title: The general appoints his own officers to key posts
general_atamalari.text: Three important commands changed hands at the General Staff. All of them went to Arden's former students.

choices.label: Block the appointments
choices.text: Arden backed down, but his gaze changed.

choices.label: Approve them
choices.text: The army now belongs to Arden. Its loyalty to you depends on his goodwill.

choices.label: Counterbalance: empower Vale
choices.text: Intelligence and the army are keeping an eye on each other.

kis_krizi.title: A harsh winter, energy prices
kis_krizi.text: Natural gas prices have doubled. Sarne is making a fortune from energy companies.

choices.label: Subsidize households
choices.text: Bills fell; the budget took a hit.

choices.label: Tax energy companies
choices.text: Sarne is furious, but the Treasury is full.

choices.label: Let the market decide
choices.text: Prices soared.

ignore.text: The winter grew harsher; no one intervened.

kral_hasta.title: 'Is the King ill?'
kral_hasta.text: Outside the Palace, people are saying the King has not been seen for two days. No one has made an official statement.

choices.label: Appear at a public ceremony
choices.text: You stood tall before the crowd.

choices.label: Deny it through Sarne's media
choices.text: The rumor went quiet. Sarne knows what you did.

choices.label: Ignore it
choices.text: The rumor grew.

ignore.text: The rumor spread through the Palace corridors.

prens_hirs.title: The Prince meets nobles in secret
prens_hirs.text: Reports say your brother, Prince Marcus, has dined with every noble family in the last two weeks.

choices.label: Place him under Palace watch
choices.text: The Prince stayed home. Something changed in his eyes.

choices.label: Give him an important post
choices.text: The Prince accepted gladly. His ambition grew, too.

choices.label: Have Vale watch him
choices.text: Vale is taking notes.

fact.text: The Prince placed under secret surveillance

muhalefet_birlesme.title: The opposition unites its two wings
muhalefet_birlesme.text: Adrian Voss is trying to bring the divided opposition together on a single list.

choices.label: Split them with secret money
choices.text: The two wings turned on each other. But the money trail remains.

choices.label: Negotiate with Voss
choices.text: Voss gained a seat; you gained time.

choices.label: Arrest Voss
choices.text: The opposition fell silent; the streets grew angry.

yargic_dosya.title: The High Court probes ministerial tenders
yargic_dosya.text: Chief Prosecutor Renn has opened the tender files of two ministers. One trail may lead back to the Palace.

choices.label: Apply pressure
choices.text: Renn backed off, but the pressure was put in writing.

choices.label: Let it proceed
choices.text: The case is moving forward. It may not protect you, but it will not tarnish your name either.

choices.label: Sacrifice the minister
choices.text: A minister fell; the case was closed. What the minister knows was not.

ignore.text: The case moved through the courts.

fact.text: The ministerial tender file's link to the Palace

voss_dosyalar.title: Intelligence chief compiles files on politicians
voss_dosyalar.text: Vale's archives grow by the day. Some files concern people from your own Palace.

choices.label: Demand the files
choices.text: Vale handed them over. He may have kept a copy.

choices.label: Expand his authority
choices.text: Vale now knows something about everyone. Including you.

choices.label: Pit him against the Army
choices.text: Arden and Vale are watching each other.

ignore.text: Vale carried on with his work.

sinir_krizi.title: Border tensions with a neighboring state
sinir_krizi.text: An armed incident took place in a border village. The neighboring country's press is beating the drums of war.

choices.label: Declare mobilization
choices.text: The public changed the subject. The Army gained weight.

choices.label: Choose diplomacy
choices.text: Tensions cooled; the Army is displeased.

choices.label: Feed the press
choices.text: Sarne filled the headlines. The bill can wait.

butce_acigi.title: The budget deficit is growing
butce_acigi.text: Prime Minister Veyra says salaries cannot be paid without cuts.

choices.label: Approve the cuts
choices.text: Austerity began. The public will pin it on you.

choices.label: Borrow from Sarne
choices.text: The Treasury is full. The debt bears your name.

choices.label: Hide the figures
choices.text: The honest Veyra did not like that request.

ignore.text: The deficit grew all by itself.

deepfake.title: A fake video of the King is spreading
deepfake.text: A video of the King making insulting remarks is spreading on social media. No one knows what is real.

choices.label: Call it 'fake'
choices.text: Things settled down. Your next denial will be less convincing.

choices.label: Apologize
choices.text: You looked honest, but weak.

choices.label: Have Vale find the source
choices.text: Vale found a source. Whether it is real remains unclear.

ignore.text: The video was watched millions of times.

gizli_toplanti.title: Rumors of secret meetings
gizli_toplanti.text: They say several powerful figures met in secret at a villa in the Capital.

choices.label: Have Vale watch them
choices.text: Vale confirmed the meetings, but not who attended.

choices.label: Call in each suspect
choices.text: Everyone you summoned lied to you.

choices.label: Feast for the elite
choices.text: Power became a spectacle.

ogrenci_eylem.title: Student protests spread to the universities
ogrenci_eylem.text: University squares are packed. Student representatives want to march to the city square.

choices.label: Bargain with rectors
choices.text: Some of the young people went home.

choices.label: Send in the police
choices.text: The campuses were closed. The memory stayed open.

choices.label: Let Sarne smear them
choices.text: The students were branded 'foreign agents.'

milletvekili_satin.title: Assembly budget vote
milletvekili_satin.text: The crucial budget bill looks set to pass the Assembly by only a handful of votes.

choices.label: Buy the votes
choices.text: The bill passed. A paper trail remained.

choices.label: Concede to the opposition
choices.text: The bill was softened.

choices.label: Let it fail
choices.text: The budget crisis is growing.

cenaze.title: Funeral of a former general
cenaze.text: The country's most beloved retired general has died. The entire elite will gather at the funeral; everyone will see everyone in the same room.

choices.label: Attend and speak to all
choices.text: You held a year's worth of meetings in one day.

choices.label: Hold a state funeral
choices.text: The Army's weight rose in symbolic terms.

choices.label: Stay away
choices.text: Everyone talked about your absence.

ignore.text: Your absence was the talk of the funeral.

dorn_filtre.title: The Queen narrows the appointment list
dorn_filtre.text: Queen Helena now decides who gets to see you. Some reports may no longer be reaching you.

choices.label: Trust Helena
choices.text: Helena is pleased. You now see only through her eyes.

choices.label: Warn Helena
choices.text: Helena was surprised, and a little afraid.

choices.label: Open a secret channel
choices.text: Information flows unseen. That, too, has been recorded.

toren.title: A royal ceremony is proposed
toren.text: Palace protocol proposes a grand dynastic ceremony. It is expensive, but it will dazzle the public.

choices.label: A grand ceremony
choices.text: The Capital applauded.

choices.label: A modest ceremony
choices.text: It passed as if no one had said a thing.

enflasyon.title: Inflation spills into the streets
enflasyon.text: Prices climb every week in the markets. Finance calls it 'temporary.'

choices.label: Lean on the central bank
choices.text: Rates fell; the markets remain wary.

choices.label: Impose harsh austerity
choices.text: The bitter medicine begins.

choices.label: Blame foreign media
choices.text: The headlines changed. Inflation did not.

skandal_bakan.title: A minister's corruption scandal
skandal_bakan.text: The press says one of your ministers moved money abroad. Journalists await a statement from the Palace.

choices.label: Sack the minister
choices.text: The minister fell. The public is satisfied—for now.

choices.label: Bury the scandal
choices.text: Sarne's media found another subject.

choices.label: Shield the minister
choices.text: The minister owes you. The press is on the attack.

arden_bakanlik.title: Arden sends the bill
arden_bakanlik.text: General Arden, who dispersed the protests, now wants the Ministry of Defense under his command too. “You remember who cleared the squares.”

choices.label: Give him the ministry
choices.text: Arden is pleased. He now commands the army and controls its budget.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.text: Arden saluted and left. His salute was shorter than usual.

choices.label: Appoint a loyal nobody
choices.text: Your man took the ministry. The army took it as an insult.

lena_kitap.title: Silenced journalist publishes a book abroad
lena_kitap.text: Leyla Sarn has left the country. Her book, “The Silent Palace of Veloria,” tops the bestseller lists in neighboring countries. Your name appears in it, too.

choices.label: Ban the book
choices.text: The ban only made the book more intriguing.

choices.label: Ignore it
choices.text: The Palace fell silent. The book kept talking.

choices.label: Launch a counter-campaign
choices.text: Leyla was branded a “foreign agent.” Sarne knows exactly what he wants.

ignore.text: The book is now circulating at home, hand to hand.

halden_intikam.title: Sarne's channels attack the Palace
halden_intikam.text: Since the contract file was published, all of Sarne's channels have spent every evening recounting the Palace's waste.

choices.label: Offer peace
choices.text: Sarne halted the attacks. It came out of his own pocket.

choices.label: Audit his companies
choices.text: Sarne's companies are under audit. He is fuming.

choices.label: Hit back on state media
choices.text: The two sides' channels devour each other. The public trusts neither.

voss_hakkinda.title: Vale has a file on you, too
voss_hakkinda.text: Helena whispers: a thick folder marked “Your Majesty” was spotted in Vale's archive.

choices.label: Give Vale more power
choices.text: Vale is pleased. The file remains right where it is.

choices.label: Burn the archive
choices.text: A fire broke out in the archive one night. Vale knows who started it.

choices.label: Confront Vale
choices.text: You both threatened each other without quite making a threat.

prens_kacis.title: The Prince escapes surveillance
prens_kacis.text: Prince Marcus vanished from the Palace one night. In a neighboring capital, he speaks of the “rightful dynasty” before the cameras.

choices.label: Demand his return
choices.text: The neighboring state is stalling. The Prince grows more famous by the day.

choices.label: Pardon and recall him
choices.text: The Prince returned. Grateful—or merely patient?

choices.label: Leave him in exile
choices.text: The Prince stayed in exile. His power at court ebbed, but his voice grew louder abroad.

ignore.text: The Prince is gathering supporters abroad.

prens_veliaht.title: The Prince wants to be heir
prens_veliaht.text: Prince Marcus, successful in the post you gave him, wants to be formally declared heir.

choices.label: Name him heir
choices.text: The Prince is now the next king. The only thing he must wait for is you.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.text: The Prince bowed his head. The nobles' dinners resumed.

choices.label: Offer a marriage pact
choices.text: The Prince became engaged to Sarne's daughter. Two power centers joined.

ignore.text: The Prince is waiting for an answer.

brandt_hapis.title: Voss writes from prison
brandt_hapis.text: Letters from imprisoned opposition leader Adrian Voss are pasted on walls every week.

choices.label: Release him
choices.text: Voss walked free to a crowd. Anger eased a little; the legend grew.

choices.label: Offer parole
choices.text: Voss agreed to leave politics. For now.

choices.label: Isolate him
choices.text: The letters stopped. The streets did not.

muhalefet_para.title: Questions over money splitting the opposition
muhalefet_para.text: A civil society report lists the bank accounts of lawmakers who profited from the opposition's split.

choices.label: Blame intelligence
choices.text: Vale's name came up. Vale will not forget it.

choices.label: Suppress the report
choices.text: The report vanished. The rumors did not.

choices.label: Deny everything
choices.text: The denial made the headlines. So did the documents.

ignore.text: The report is passing from hand to hand.

falk_istifa.title: Chief prosecutor Renn considers resigning
falk_istifa.text: Fed up with the pressure, Chief Prosecutor Renn left a letter on your desk: 'I am either independent or I am nothing.'

choices.label: Accept and appoint a loyalist
choices.text: The courts are yours now. So is the fact that they no longer convince anyone.

choices.label: Talk him around
choices.text: Renn stayed. Her independence is sharper than ever.

choices.label: Turn up the pressure
choices.text: Renn fell silent. A copy of the letter, however, is missing.

ignore.text: Renn announced her decision to the press.

kessler_istifa.title: The prime minister left a resignation letter
kessler_istifa.text: Selin Veyra is worn down by fear. Her letter says, 'I can no longer give you the right figures.'

choices.label: Accept her resignation
choices.text: Veyra is gone. Her replacement always brings you good news.

choices.label: Offer trust and a raise
choices.text: Veyra stayed; she is a little less tense.

choices.label: Threaten her
choices.text: Veyra stayed. Her reports look better than ever.

ignore.text: Veyra no longer comes to meetings.

gercek_kayit.title: This time, the recording is real
gercek_kayit.text: A recording has surfaced: it really is your voice. But the public has heard the word 'fake' from you before.

choices.label: Call it 'fake' again
choices.text: This time, no one believed you.

choices.label: Admit it and apologize
choices.text: Honesty salvaged a little of your standing.

choices.label: Change the subject with Sarne
choices.text: The channels moved on to another crisis. The bill will come later.

ignore.text: The recording is on everyone's phone.

terhis.title: Mobilization is over; the Army won't stand down
terhis.text: The border has quieted. But the mobilized units remain around the Capital.

choices.label: Order them to stand down
choices.text: The units dispersed. Some officers are not pleased.

choices.label: Build a permanent garrison
choices.text: There is now a permanent army around the Capital.

choices.label: Pay the officers a bonus
choices.text: The army is pleased. Your coffers are a little lighter.

ignore.text: The units remain where they are.

liman_skandali.title: Port contract scandal hits the papers
liman_skandali.text: A dockworker gave a newspaper the commission papers from the port contract.

choices.label: Sacrifice Sarne
choices.text: Sarne was arrested. He is ready to tell them everything he knows.

choices.label: Shut down the paper
choices.text: The paper folded. The story appeared in ten other places.

choices.label: Blame the ministry
choices.text: A minister was accused. Veyra watched the game unfold.

dorn_rusvet.title: The Royal Foundation sells access
dorn_rusvet.text: It turns out that anyone seeking an audience with you had to make a 'donation' to the Royal Foundation. Helena, apparently, decided who got to see you.

choices.label: Banish Helena from the Palace
choices.text: Helena left the Palace, taking all its secrets with her.

choices.label: Look the other way
choices.text: Helena is grateful. Your door is now entirely hers.

choices.label: Use Helena to stall your rivals
choices.text: Your rivals can no longer see you. Remember, you can no longer see them either.

ignore.text: The market at your door is booming.

butce_ifsa.title: The hidden budget deficit is exposed
butce_ifsa.text: An international lender published Veloria's declared figures beside the real ones.

choices.label: Blame Veyra
choices.text: Veyra became the scapegoat. She will never forget it.

choices.label: Tell the truth
choices.text: The markets shook, but more people came to trust you.

choices.label: Call it 'foreign interference'
choices.text: The story changed; interest rates rose.

arden_posterleri.title: The public puts up Arden's posters
arden_posterleri.text: General Arden's posters cover the Capital's walls. One word beneath them: 'Order.'

choices.label: Honor Arden in a ceremony
choices.text: Some of Arden's light fell on you. Or the other way around.

choices.label: Push him into retirement
choices.text: Arden refused to retire; his units back him.

choices.label: Quietly pull down the posters
choices.text: The posters are gone. Their marks remain on the walls.

yabanci_elci.title: A foreign ambassador requests a secret meeting
yabanci_elci.text: An ambassador from a powerful neighbor offers generous support in exchange for 'stability.' Off the books.

choices.label: Take the money
choices.text: Your coffers are full. Now you owe a foreign power, too.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.text: The ambassador smiled politely and went to meet the opposition.

choices.label: Leave it to Vale
choices.text: Vale is talking to both sides.

ignore.text: The ambassador is knocking on other doors.

erken_secim.title: The Assembly debates an early election
erken_secim.text: The opposition and some government MPs are gathering signatures for an early election.

choices.label: Dissolve the Assembly
choices.text: The Assembly closed. The streets began to fill.

choices.label: Allow the election
choices.text: The election date was announced. Your legitimacy rose; your power was tested.

choices.label: Offer the opposition a ministry
choices.text: Voss's party joined the government. The opposition split.

yildonumu.title: The first anniversary of your coronation
yildonumu.text: Palace protocol has offered three ways to mark the anniversary. Every power center is watching how you celebrate.

choices.label: Hold a grand celebration
choices.text: The Capital lit up. The Treasury dimmed a little.

choices.label: Declare a general amnesty
choices.text: The prisoners went free. Even the opposition applauded.

choices.label: Let it pass quietly
choices.text: No one celebrated. No one forgot, either.

voss_arden_catisma.title: Intelligence is listening to the Army
voss_arden_catisma.text: Arden has learned that Vale had the General Staff's phones tapped. Both want to see you today.

choices.label: Back Vale
choices.text: Vale is pleased. Arden shut the door a little harder.

choices.label: Back Arden
choices.text: The tapping stopped. Vale made sure to keep the recordings.

choices.label: Reprimand them both
choices.text: Both backed down. Their distrust of each other worked in your favor.

ignore.text: The feud grew on its own.

lena_roportaj.title: A reporter asks for an interview
lena_roportaj.text: Leyla Sarn wants an interview without censorship. 'The people want to hear from you directly.'

choices.label: Give an honest interview
choices.text: People talked about the interview. Some believed you for the first time.

choices.label: Demand the questions in advance
choices.text: Leyla sent the questions—and mentioned that in the interview.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.text: The next day's paper had a blank page: 'The King Did Not Speak.'

brandt_koalisyon.title: Voss offers a coalition
brandt_koalisyon.text: The opposition is strong. Voss offers to join the government in exchange for calming the streets.

choices.label: Accept
choices.text: The opposition entered government. The streets calmed; Voss's power moved into the Palace.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.text: Voss returned to the rallies.

choices.label: Accept, then undermine them
choices.text: A coalition formed. Vale has been watching the opposition ministers from day one.

ignore.text: The offer waits on the table; the opposition is growing impatient.

anayasa_degisikligi.title: A constitutional amendment to expand your powers
anayasa_degisikligi.text: Your advisers have drafted a constitutional amendment granting the King emergency powers.

choices.label: Put it to a referendum
choices.text: The people voted. Whatever the result, your legitimacy grew.

choices.label: Pass it by decree
choices.text: The powers are yours. The High Court's silence is deafening.

choices.label: Drop it
choices.text: The draft stayed in a drawer.

halden_kanal.title: Sarne moves to buy the last independent channel
halden_kanal.text: Sarne has bid for the country's last independent television channel. If it sells, every news bulletin will come from one hand.

choices.label: Allow the sale
choices.text: Every screen belongs to Sarne now. And, in a way, to you.

choices.label: Block it through regulators
choices.text: The sale was halted. Sarne took it personally.

choices.label: Have the state buy it
choices.text: The channel now belongs to the state. We will see how much the public trusts state television.

kessler_reform.title: Veyra proposes a bold reform
kessler_reform.text: The Prime Minister wants to rewrite the tax system. 'It will hurt today, save us a year from now.'

choices.label: Enact the reform
choices.text: The reform began. The first months will be hard.

choices.label: Water it down
choices.text: Half the reform remained—and half the effect.

choices.label: Reject it
choices.text: Veyra put the report in a drawer. The light in her eyes dimmed a little.

reform_meyve.title: The reform bears fruit
reform_meyve.text: A year after Veyra's tax reform, the Treasury is filling and investors are returning.

choices.label: Claim the credit
choices.text: The headlines speak of 'the King's reform.' Veyra is silent.

choices.label: Thank Veyra
choices.text: Veyra received the praise. Her loyalty deepened.

ignore.text: The reform quietly did its work.

genel_grev.title: A general strike
genel_grev.text: The unions have called a nationwide general strike. Ports, factories, and buses have stopped.

choices.label: Reach a deal with the unions
choices.text: Wages rose; the strike ended. The Treasury felt it.

choices.label: Ban the strike
choices.text: The strike was banned. The anger was not.

choices.label: Wait them out
choices.text: The strike dragged on for weeks.

suikast.title: An attempt on your procession
suikast.text: Gunfire struck your procession on the way back from a ceremony. You survived. You wonder less who pulled the trigger than who gave the order.

choices.label: Purge the security detail
choices.text: The guards were replaced. Vale is leading the investigation; he knows everything.

choices.label: Declare martial law
choices.text: Tanks filled the streets. Order returned, along with the Army's power.

choices.label: Face the people
choices.text: You stepped onto the balcony with an injured arm. The crowd applauded.

dorn_sir.title: The Queen knows your private life
dorn_sir.text: Helena murmured as she poured a drink one evening: 'I told no one about your late-night visits last month, Your Majesty.'

choices.label: Expand her foundation's powers
choices.text: Helena is pleased with her new authority. Your secret grew with it.

choices.label: Buy her silence
choices.text: Helena took the envelope and thanked you. It will not be the first.

choices.label: Threaten her
choices.text: Helena went pale and fell silent. Then she began writing something down.

ignore.text: Helena said nothing. That does not mean she never will.

prens_suikast.title: An attempt on the Prince's life
prens_suikast.text: Prince Marcus narrowly survived an assassination attempt. Everyone in the Palace is looking at you, quietly.

choices.label: Open an inquiry
choices.text: Vale found a culprit. Not everyone was convinced.

choices.label: Give the Prince a personal guard
choices.text: The Prince accepted the guard. He asked who had chosen them.

choices.label: Say nothing
choices.text: Your silence was read like a confession.

dis_borc.title: A foreign loan with harsh terms
dis_borc.text: An international body offers a loan. In return, it wants austerity and 'transparent governance.'

choices.label: Accept the loan
choices.text: The Treasury could breathe again. Austerity enraged the streets.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.text: Sovereignty was preserved; the coffers stayed empty.

choices.label: Borrow from Sarne's bank
choices.text: The money came from home. The debt belonged to Sarne.

veliaht_sorunu.title: The throne has no heir
veliaht_sorunu.text: The nobles and the Assembly began asking the same question: the King has no heir. If you fall, who inherits the crown?

choices.label: Arrange a noble marriage alliance
choices.text: The engagement was announced. The nobles were pleased; the Prince saw his place in line grow more distant.

choices.label: Name the Prince heir
choices.text: The uncertainty ended. The Prince no longer has to wait—only to keep waiting.

choices.label: Close the matter
choices.text: The question did not close; it merely became a whisper.

ordu_modernizasyon.title: The Army wants new weapons
ordu_modernizasyon.text: The General Staff is demanding a large budget to buy modern armored vehicles from a foreign supplier.

choices.label: Approve the budget
choices.text: The Army modernized. A stronger Army means a stronger general.

choices.label: Approve half
choices.text: The Army was half pleased; the Treasury half empty.

choices.label: Refuse and fund the police
choices.text: The police grew stronger; the Army grew jealous.

ignore.text: The request was shelved; the officers grumbled.

voss_emeklilik.title: Vale wants to retire
voss_emeklilik.text: Intelligence Chief Vale says he is tired. But what becomes of his thirty-year archive?

choices.label: Let him go; take the archive
choices.text: Vale left quietly. They say a copy of the archive went with him.

choices.label: Persuade him to stay
choices.text: Vale stayed. The price was high.

choices.label: Take the archive first
choices.text: The files are in your safe now. Vale took it as a sign of distrust.

ignore.text: Vale postponed his resignation, not his impatience.

halden_parti.title: Sarne is forming a political party
halden_parti.text: Victor Sarne announced that, with his channels' support, he would form a party called 'New Veloria.'

choices.label: Back the party and control it
choices.text: Sarne's party entered the Assembly and acts like your man. For now.

choices.label: Have the election board block it
choices.text: The party was never formed. Sarne is now an open enemy.

choices.label: Set Sarne against the opposition
choices.text: Voss and Sarne are tearing at each other. You watch.

lena_odul.title: A journalist wins an international award
lena_odul.text: Leyla Sarn won an international press award for her reports on corruption in Veloria. At the ceremony, she remembered to thank you—or to imply as much.

choices.label: Invite her to the Palace
choices.text: The photograph spread everywhere. The image of an honest ruler.

choices.label: Ignore it
choices.text: The Palace stayed silent.

choices.label: Have Sarne's media smear the award
choices.text: The award was branded 'foreign interference.' Leyla will write more sharply now.

ignore.text: The award fell out of the news.

prens_ordu.title: The Prince is meeting with generals
prens_ordu.text: Reports say Prince Marcus has had private dinners with three division commanders in the past two weeks.

choices.label: Reassign the commanders
choices.text: The commanders were sent to the border. The Prince got the message.

choices.label: Speak openly with the Prince
choices.text: Your brother smiled and denied nothing.

choices.label: Demand Arden's oath of loyalty
choices.text: Arden swore. The oath will come at a price.

salgin.title: An outbreak in the Capital
salgin.text: A fast-spreading illness has filled the hospitals. Doctors want a quarantine; merchants do not.

choices.label: Impose a strict quarantine
choices.text: The outbreak slowed; the shops closed.

choices.label: Take mild measures
choices.text: The economy kept moving; the hospitals filled.

choices.label: Do nothing; let Sarne speak
choices.text: The channels called it 'exaggerated panic.' The funerals said otherwise.

ikinci_kis.title: A second harsh winter
ikinci_kis.text: Another winter has arrived; the storehouses are emptier than last year. The people remember what you did last year.

choices.label: Open the storehouses to the public
choices.text: No one froze. The Treasury did.

choices.label: Ration energy
choices.text: Fair, but a cold winter.

choices.label: Buy emergency supplies from Sarne
choices.text: The gas arrived; the bill was entered as a debt to Sarne.

sinir_ikinci.title: A second border crisis
sinir_ikinci.text: A neighboring state is massing tanks along the border. This is no village incident; embassies are being evacuated.

choices.label: Mobilize the entire Army
choices.text: Flags filled the country; the Army marched as if it owned the place.

choices.label: Negotiate in secret
choices.text: A phone call ended the crisis. No one knows how.

choices.label: Request international mediation
choices.text: The crisis slowly subsided; you looked weak.

secim_sonucu.title: Election results
secim_sonucu.text: The early election results are in. The opposition did better than expected; the Assembly must form a new government.

choices.label: Accept the result
choices.text: Your legitimacy grew; your power was shared.

choices.label: Challenge the results
choices.text: The court rejected the challenge; the streets grew angry.

choices.label: Arrange defections
choices.text: A few members switched sides. The majority is yours; so is the money trail.

halef_karari.title: A legacy for the throne
halef_karari.text: Two years are nearly up. Every power center is asking one question: what kind of country will Veloria be after you?

choices.label: Declare a constitutional monarchy
choices.text: You gave the Assembly real power. History will remember; so will the generals.

choices.label: Name the Prince as your heir
choices.text: The dynasty will continue. The Prince's fate is now tied to yours.

choices.label: Make absolute power permanent
choices.text: The Crown is now shared with no institution. The silence is profound.

yeni_protesto.title: New protests fill the squares
yeni_protesto.text: The Capital's squares filled again. This time, your name was on the banners.

choices.label: Disperse them with police
choices.text: The square emptied; the anger did not.

choices.label: Call the representatives to the Palace
choices.text: You talked. Some were persuaded.

choices.label: Stage a counter-rally
choices.text: Two crowds faced each other. The streets grew tense.

yolsuzluk_iddiasi.title: A new corruption allegation
yolsuzluk_iddiasi.text: A deputy minister's tender commissions are in the press. The Palace has not been named yet.

choices.label: Open an investigation
choices.text: The deputy minister fell. The courts did their job.

choices.label: Bury the matter
choices.text: The matter was buried; the file was not.

choices.label: Blame the opposition
choices.text: The channels blamed the opposition. The public split in two.

soylu_ziyafeti.title: The nobles want a feast
soylu_ziyafeti.text: Old noble families want a traditional feast at the Palace. Who gets invited is a message in itself.

choices.label: Hold a grand feast
choices.text: The nobles left pleased; your coffers lighter.

choices.label: Invite only loyal families
choices.text: Those left off the list took note.

choices.label: Cancel the feast
choices.text: The public applauded the savings; the nobles did not.

yabanci_basin.title: Foreign press asks for an interview
yabanci_basin.text: An international newspaper wants to interview the King about recent events in Veloria.

choices.label: Give a candid interview
choices.text: The world listened. Some of your words were discussed at home, too.

choices.label: Stick to prepared answers
choices.text: The interview was dull but harmless.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.text: The paper ran the headline: 'Veloria's silent King.'

ikinci_yil_butce.title: The second year's budget
ikinci_yil_butce.text: Veyra brought the second year's budget. No line has been left blank this time, but you're asked to rank three priorities.

choices.label: Security first
choices.text: The Army and police grew stronger; schools will have to wait.

choices.label: The people first
choices.text: Welfare rose; so did the deficit.

choices.label: The Treasury first
choices.text: The deficit closed. Belts tightened.

ignore.text: The budget passed on Veyra's proposal.

odeme_defteri.title: The ledger of secret payments
odeme_defteri.text: Queen Helena left a small, battered ledger on your desk one night: a date-by-date record of the secret payments you made over the past year. 'I didn't keep this, Your Majesty. But I know who did.'

choices.label: Buy the ledger; silence its owner
choices.text: The ledger was burned; its owner is now on your payroll. Helena saw everything.

choices.label: Have Veyra book it as 'diplomatic expenses'
choices.text: The payments became a line in the budget. Veyra signed, washed her hands—and couldn't get them clean.

choices.label: Return it to Helena: 'Burn it.'
choices.text: Helena took the ledger. You're not sure she burned it.

ignore.text: The ledger sat on your desk for a week, then disappeared.

defter_kopya.title: A second copy of the ledger
defter_kopya.text: Copies of the ledger you thought you had burned turned up in a lawyer's safe. The lawyer names no price, only a name: Helena.

choices.label: Send Helena away
choices.text: Helena left quietly. The copies went with her; you have no idea where.

choices.label: Strike a new deal with Helena
choices.text: Helena's powers grew. The copies stayed in the safe.

choices.label: Leave the lawyer to Vale
choices.text: The lawyer left the country. Vale opened another file.

ignore.text: The copies are waiting in the safe.

yazili_emirler.title: Copies of the written orders reach court
yazili_emirler.text: Chief Prosecutor Renn's prosecutors want the originals of the written suppression orders you issued last year. They already have the copies; now they ask whether the signature is yours.

choices.label: Hand over the originals
choices.text: Your signature entered the court record. Renn looked at you with respect for the first time; the generals looked worried for the first time.

choices.label: Call the signatures forged
choices.text: The Palace issued a stern denial. The prosecutors called in a handwriting expert.

choices.label: Have Vale clear the archive
choices.text: The originals vanished from the archive. Vale will ask for payment later.

ignore.text: The prosecutors settled for the copies; the case file keeps growing.

santaj_kurbani.title: Someone you blackmailed is ready to talk
santaj_kurbani.text: The person you bound with fear last year is afraid no longer. Word is they met with a publisher and are writing a book about 'the king's methods.'

choices.label: Make a generous offer
choices.text: The book was never written. The bill was enormous.

choices.label: Have Vale build a case
choices.text: The book stalled halfway. Another file went into Vale's drawer.

choices.label: Apologize in person
choices.text: A king's apology is a rare sight. The book never appeared; the rumor did.

ignore.text: The book is with the publisher.

terfi_rekabet.title: Your appointees turn on each other
terfi_rekabet.text: The people you promoted now want the same seat. Arden's and Vale's men are openly blaming each other over a ministry post.

choices.label: Back Arden
choices.text: The Army won. Vale will not forget the loss.

choices.label: Back Vale
choices.text: The intelligence service won. The barracks are grumbling.

choices.label: Give neither the post
choices.text: A civilian got the post. They both blame you, not each other.

bozulan_sozler.title: The king who breaks his word
bozulan_sozler.text: At a noble's banquet, someone raised a glass: 'To His Majesty's promises!' Laughter followed. Your broken promise has become a joke.

choices.label: Pay back the old promise
choices.text: Generosity, long overdue. The joke was forgotten; the Treasury remembered.

choices.label: Send the toastsman away
choices.text: The banquets grew quiet. No one raises a glass to your word anymore—or to your health.

choices.label: Laugh it off
choices.text: You smiled. No one will believe your next promise.

operasyon_sizdi.title: A member of the operations team is writing a memoir
operasyon_sizdi.text: A former agent from one of your secret operations has signed with a publisher abroad. The first chapter is titled 'In the Palace's Name.'

choices.label: Bring the agent back
choices.text: The agent returned. The new assignment: keep quiet.

choices.label: Sue the publisher
choices.text: The lawsuit stopped the book and made sure everyone read it.

choices.label: Smear the draft through Sarne
choices.text: Sarne called the agent a 'foreign agent.' The book faded into the shadows; now you owe Sarne again.

ignore.text: The draft is moving through the publisher.

iyi_kral_ani.title: A letter from an old teacher
iyi_kral_ani.text: A letter arrived from the provinces. An old man who taught you history as a child writes: 'I hear you rule without fear. Can you keep it up?'

choices.label: Share the letter
choices.text: The papers printed the letter. For a moment, people loved their king.

choices.label: Invite him to the Palace
choices.text: The old man stayed for an afternoon. He left you one piece of advice: 'Fear those who lie to themselves.'

choices.label: Leave it unanswered
choices.text: The letter went into a drawer.

arden_halef.title: Arden is grooming his successor
arden_halef.text: General Arden has chosen his successor at the General Staff: his own nephew. At military academy ceremonies, Arden's name is now read before yours.

choices.label: Approve the appointment
choices.text: The Army's future belongs to the Arden family. So does its present.

choices.label: Block it; appoint a civilian
choices.text: The barracks made the civilian minister's name a joke. But the seal is yours.

choices.label: Send him to the border
choices.text: His nephew is far away. Arden is angry, but quiet.

ignore.text: The appointment is a done deal.

voss_sigorta.title: Vale's insurance policy
voss_sigorta.text: Over tea one evening, Vale said calmly: 'If anything happens to me, my files go to a foreign paper. This is no threat, Your Majesty. It's insurance.'

choices.label: Accept it; protect Vale
choices.text: Vale is untouchable now. So are you—in his files.

choices.label: Collect his files too
choices.text: A race began. Whose files will be thicker?

choices.label: Force Vale to retire
choices.text: Vale left. So did the files; you'll soon learn where.

ignore.text: Vale finished his tea and left.

halden_imparatorluk.title: Sarne is buying the papers too
halden_imparatorluk.text: Sarne's company bought the last two major papers and their distribution network. Now every headline at your breakfast table comes from his pen.

choices.label: Block the sale
choices.text: The sale was canceled. Sarne's channels criticized you for the first time.

choices.label: Approve it; demand a line
choices.text: The headlines are yours. So is your debt to Sarne.

choices.label: Have Leyla buy one paper
choices.text: One more independent paper survives. Sarne knows who arranged it.

kessler_kacis.title: Veyra's family moved abroad
kessler_kacis.text: Prime Minister Selin Veyra's wife and children have quietly moved abroad. Veyra is still at her desk, but they say her suitcase is packed.

choices.label: Assure her and increase her protection
choices.text: Veyra was relieved. You cannot tell whether she thinks the guards are protecting her or watching her.

choices.label: Let her go with dignity
choices.text: Veyra left a farewell letter. The Treasury's passwords went to the new minister, too; some did not.

choices.label: Seize her passport
choices.text: Veyra stayed. She is no longer a minister, but a hostage.

ignore.text: One morning, Veyra did not come to her desk.

lena_belgesel.title: Leyla is making a documentary about your reign
lena_belgesel.text: Leyla Sarn has made a documentary about the first year of your reign. The trailer sets your speeches beside reports and street footage.

choices.label: Give an interview for the film
choices.text: You spoke openly to the camera. The film did not soften you, but it found you honest.

choices.label: Ban the screening
choices.text: The documentary was banned—and everyone watched it.

choices.label: Have Sarne air another film tonight
choices.text: Two documentaries, two truths. The public chose which to believe; you do not know which.

dorn_anilar.title: The Queen is writing her memoirs
dorn_anilar.text: Helena writes for an hour every night. Queens do not write memoirs, Your Majesty; when they do, they know something.

choices.label: Buy the memoirs for the Palace archive
choices.text: The notebooks are in the archive. Helena has begun thinking about retirement.

choices.label: Give Helena full control of the Foundation
choices.text: Helena now runs the Foundation alone. Her pen is in the drawer; the key is in her pocket.

choices.label: Search her room in secret
choices.text: The notebooks were found. Helena knows what was found—and who looked.

generaller_muhtirasi.title: The generals' memorandum
generaller_muhtirasi.text: A signed statement arrived from the General Staff at midnight. It was politely worded: they want people in government who 'understand the country's sensitivities.' Arden's name leads the signatures.

choices.label: Give in and reshuffle the Cabinet
choices.text: Three generals are in the Cabinet. There was no coup—because there was no need.

choices.label: Send Arden away as ambassador
choices.text: Arden was sent to a distant capital. The barracks are quiet. Too quiet.

choices.label: Publish the memorandum
choices.text: The memorandum made the papers. The squares filled with calls for the Army to return to its barracks; the generals are exposed now.

ignore.text: You did not answer the memorandum. The generals are writing the reply themselves.

muhtira_sonrasi.title: The generals in the Cabinet
muhtira_sonrasi.text: The generals you brought into the Cabinet now run the ministers, not just the ministries. Veyra called the General Staff before signing a budget line.

choices.label: Keep the generals in the Cabinet
choices.text: Order was restored. You do not ask whose order.

choices.label: Bring one down in a bribery scandal
choices.text: One general is gone. The others learned a lesson; which lesson is unclear.

choices.label: Announce the election calendar
choices.text: Civilians found hope again; the generals began calculating.

halden_meclis.title: Sarne is buying the Assembly
halden_meclis.text: Sarne's coffers opened: eleven MPs changed parties in a single night. The Assembly now debates Sarne's contracts, not your laws.

choices.label: Partner with Sarne
choices.text: The laws pass. None without Sarne's signature.

choices.label: Ask Renn to investigate the defections
choices.text: The court files are swelling; Sarne's channels have branded you a 'dictator.'

choices.label: Dissolve the Assembly
choices.text: The Assembly closed. Sarne's MPs and yours both went home.

ignore.text: The MPs are at Sarne's table.

cadir_kent.title: A tent city in the square
cadir_kent.text: The protesters are not going home. Tents have sprung up in the main square: a kitchen, a clinic, a library. A city that is not yours is growing in the heart of the Capital.

choices.label: Put their demands on the table
choices.text: Prices were frozen; several ministers left. The tents came down one by one.

choices.label: Break it up in a night raid
choices.text: The square was clear by morning. The photographs had already reached abroad.

choices.label: Wait for winter
choices.text: The cold scattered some tents. Those who remained were more determined.

soylular_meclisi.title: The Prince summons the Council of Nobles
soylular_meclisi.text: The Council of Nobles, not convened in a century, gathered at the summer Palace at Prince Marcus's call. There was one item on the agenda: 'the health of the Crown.'

choices.label: Join and preside over the Council
choices.text: The nobles rose and bowed. The smile on the Prince's face was not real.

choices.label: Declare the meeting illegal
choices.text: The guards shut the doors. The nobles will not forget this.

choices.label: Give the Prince a post abroad
choices.text: The Prince is on a long diplomatic tour. His letters arrive every week, each one shorter than the last.

dosyalar_birlesiyor.title: The High Court joins the cases
dosyalar_birlesiyor.text: Chief Prosecutor Renn has joined every case opened over the past two years into a single investigation. The file has a short name: 'The Palace.'

choices.label: Agree to testify
choices.text: You took the stand. The questions were hard, but the King was seen to obey the law.

choices.label: Pass an immunity law
choices.text: The law passed. The Court will wait—for the day you are no longer on the throne.

choices.label: Send Renn into retirement
choices.text: Renn is gone; the file is on new judges' desks. And in the papers.

derin_devlet.title: Vale's shadow cabinet
derin_devlet.text: Vale's people are in the ministries, making decisions the ministers do not know about. This morning, you learned of a governor's appointment from the paper.

choices.label: Make Vale's network official
choices.text: The shadow cabinet is no longer in the shadows. Vale's signature sits beside yours.

choices.label: Turn Vale and Arden against each other
choices.text: The Army listens to intelligence; intelligence listens to the Army. Both have forgotten you—for now.

choices.label: Dismiss the governors one by one
choices.text: The appointments were revoked. Vale smiled; he has other lists.

ignore.text: The shadow cabinet is in session.

kuraklik.title: Drought
kuraklik.text: There has been no rain for three months. Grain reserves are halved, and farmers are moving to the cities. Veyra says 'foreign grain'; Arden says 'troops at the granaries.'

choices.label: Buy grain abroad
choices.text: Bread prices held steady; the Treasury melted away.

choices.label: Hand the granaries to the Army
choices.text: Distribution is orderly; the queues are long and quiet.

choices.label: Open the Palace pantries
choices.text: The Palace pantries opened to the public. Good photographs; empty shelves.

maden_faciasi.title: A mine disaster
maden_faciasi.text: A mine in the north has collapsed, trapping forty-two workers. The mine belongs to one of Sarne's companies; its safety reports have gone unsigned for two years.

choices.label: Hold Sarne responsible
choices.text: Sarne paid compensation and never forgave you.

choices.label: Declare national mourning; slow the inquiry
choices.text: The flags flew at half-mast. The reports went into a cabinet.

choices.label: Attend the funerals yourself
choices.text: A king among miners' widows. No one knew what to say—not even you.

ignore.text: The funerals were crowded and angry.

yabanci_yatirimci.title: A foreign fund wants the port
yabanci_yatirimci.text: A sovereign wealth fund from a distant country wants to lease the Capital's port for forty years. The offer is generous; the terms are in the fine print.

choices.label: Accept
choices.text: The Treasury filled. Another flag flew over the port.

choices.label: Accept only if Sarne joins
choices.text: Sarne joined, too. Everyone won—except the public.

choices.label: Refuse
choices.text: The port is yours. The Treasury is empty.

ignore.text: The fund moved on to another port.

multeciler.title: Refugees at the border
multeciler.text: Thousands fleeing the civil war in a neighboring country are waiting at the border. Arden wants the gates closed; Voss wants them open.

choices.label: Open the gates
choices.text: Camps went up. The world applauded; the provinces grumbled.

choices.label: Close the gates
choices.text: The border is quiet. The photographs are not.

choices.label: Admit them in exchange for aid
choices.text: The aid arrived, and so did the camps. No one is happy; everyone accepts it.

ignore.text: The people at the border keep waiting.

ulusal_bayram.title: National holiday
ulusal_bayram.text: Preparations are under way for the holiday parade. One question has split the Palace: who will march at the front?

choices.label: Put the Army at the front
choices.text: Tanks rolled down the boulevard. Arden thought the crowd was saluting him, not you.

choices.label: Put students and workers at the front
choices.text: The parade was colorful. The generals looked bored in the stands.

choices.label: Cancel the parade; fund hospitals
choices.text: The boulevard was empty. The hospitals have new beds.

saray_tarihcisi.title: The Palace historian wants access to the archives
saray_tarihcisi.text: The official historian has begun a book about your reign and wants access to the entire archive. 'History will be written, Your Majesty. If I write it, at least the spelling will be right.'

choices.label: Open the entire archive
choices.text: The historian read everything. The book will be honest, and you will be in it.

choices.label: Allow selected documents only
choices.text: The book will be beautiful. No one will believe it.

choices.label: Dictate the book yourself
choices.text: The historian took notes; his eyes said something else.

ignore.text: The historian found sources of his own.

halef_spekulasyonu.title: Foreign papers speculate about your successor
halef_spekulasyonu.text: Foreign newspapers are writing about what comes after you: a Prince, a general, an Assembly? Everyone in the Capital reads the stories; no one admits it.

choices.label: Call it a lie; promise a long reign
choices.text: The Palace said, 'His Majesty will reign for many more years.' The generals checked their calendars.

choices.label: Put the Prince forward at ceremonies
choices.text: The Prince is beside you in every photograph. The nobles do not know whom to salute.

choices.label: Say nothing
choices.text: Silence is open to every interpretation.

anayasa_taslagi.title: The opposition's draft constitution
anayasa_taslagi.text: Voss and a group of lawyers have published a draft constitution that transfers the Crown's powers to the Assembly. They say Chief Prosecutor Renn has read it.

choices.label: Open the draft to debate
choices.text: The table was set. The generals noted they had not been invited.

choices.label: Ban it and investigate its authors
choices.text: The draft was banned and multiplied on photocopiers.

choices.label: Write your own draft; have Sarne air it
choices.text: Two drafts, two television channels. The public confused which belonged to whom; that was the point.

ikinci_yildonumu.title: As the second anniversary approaches
ikinci_yildonumu.text: Two years are nearly up. No one at the Palace talks about celebrating; everyone is counting. How many are still with you, and how many are only waiting?

choices.label: Invite every power center to dinner
choices.text: Everyone came. No one raised the first glass; you did.

choices.label: Address the people
choices.text: The balcony speech was short. So was the applause.

choices.label: Keep working in silence
choices.text: One more file on your desk. The anniversary was the next one.

hamle_arden_subay.title: Arden's officers take key posts
hamle_arden_subay.news: Arden placed his own officers in command of two regiments in the Capital.

hamle_arden_tatbikat.title: Drills near the Capital
hamle_arden_tatbikat.news: Arden held an unannounced drill at the Capital's entrance. Tanks held the roads all night.

hamle_arden_yemin.title: A loyalty oath in the barracks
hamle_arden_yemin.news: Arden had his officers renew their oath of loyalty to the king at the barracks.

hamle_voss_dosya.title: Vale builds a case against a minister
hamle_voss_dosya.news: Vale prepared a new dossier on the Prime Minister; Veyra heard about it.

hamle_voss_dinleme.title: Palace lines under surveillance
hamle_voss_dinleme.news: Vale tapped several Palace phone lines 'for security reasons.'

hamle_halden_kanal.title: Sarne's channels target a minister
hamle_halden_kanal.news: Sarne's channels spent a week targeting Veyra. No one asked why Veyra was the target.

hamle_halden_ihale.title: Sarne wins another contract
hamle_halden_ihale.news: One of Sarne's companies won a bridge contract. The economy is growing; so is Sarne.

hamle_kessler_kemer.title: Veyra quietly tightens the belt
hamle_kessler_kemer.news: Without asking you, Veyra froze some social spending. The Treasury breathed easier; the bakery queues grew longer.

hamle_kessler_fazla.title: An unexpected budget surplus
hamle_kessler_fazla.news: Veyra found an unexpected surplus in tax revenue and transferred it to the Treasury.

hamle_lena_ifsa.title: Leyla exposes a minister
hamle_lena_ifsa.news: Leyla's paper published documented evidence of misconduct in a ministry.

hamle_brandt_miting.title: Voss holds a rally in the provinces
hamle_brandt_miting.news: Voss held a large rally in the provinces. Your name came up eleven times.

hamle_brandt_sendika.title: Voss reaches an agreement with the unions
hamle_brandt_sendika.news: Voss signed a joint statement with the major unions. Meetings have grown more frequent in the factories.

hamle_prens_soylular.title: The Prince dines with noble families
hamle_prens_soylular.news: The Prince dined with three noble families this week. The future of the throne was reportedly discussed at the table.

hamle_prens_vakif.title: The Prince founds a charity
hamle_prens_vakif.news: The Prince founded a charity for poor children. The people love him; the nobles are watching him.

hamle_falk_dava.title: Renn files suit against a minister
hamle_falk_dava.news: Chief Prosecutor Renn reopened a minister's tender file. The courthouse corridors are crowded.

hamle_dorn_liste.title: Helena cuts the appointment list
hamle_dorn_liste.news: Helena canceled appointments with three ministers this week, citing 'Your Majesty's fatigue.'

yay_arden_yukselis.title: Arden's officer list
yay_arden_yukselis.text: Arden left an appointment list. 'The army runs on orders, Your Majesty. No officer moves without your signature.' The seal line at the bottom is blank.

choices.label: Review the list in open session
choices.text: Review the list in open session.

choices.label: Leave appointments to Arden
choices.text: Leave the appointments to Arden.

yay_arden_sinav.title: Two orders at headquarters
yay_arden_sinav.text: A border unit received two different orders. Arden set the file on your desk: 'If politics enters headquarters, the sentry won't know whom to obey.'

choices.label: Settle it with your signature
choices.text: Settle the order with your signature.

choices.label: Let headquarters decide
choices.text: Let headquarters find its own way.

ignore.text: No decision was made; he took the silence as an answer.

yay_arden_sadakat.title: Arden protects the chain of command
yay_arden_sadakat.text: You had upheld Arden's procedure in the border order. Now, before his officers, the general points to your signature: 'In this army, the final word belongs to the Crown.'

choices.label: Speak with the commanders
choices.text: Speak alongside the commanders.

choices.label: Send Arden back to duty
choices.text: Send Arden back to his post.

yay_arden_kopus.title: The officers wait for Arden
yay_arden_kopus.text: You had left headquarters alone to handle the border order. Arden spoke sharply: 'The officers can't wait. When no order came, I gave one myself.'

choices.label: Restate the chain of command
choices.text: Restate the chain of command in writing.

choices.label: Stay silent this time
choices.text: Stay silent this time.

yay_voss_yukselis.title: Vale's intelligence desk
yay_voss_yukselis.text: Vale proposed gathering every report sent to the Palace at a single desk. 'Scattered information is unprocessed information. Let's put it in order.'

choices.label: Enter the records in one ledger
choices.text: Enter the records in a shared ledger.

choices.label: Leave the desk to Vale
choices.text: Leave the desk to Vale.

yay_voss_sinav.title: The key to a sealed file
yay_voss_sinav.text: A file bears the name of both a minister and the Palace. Without looking up, Vale asks, “Does the record go to court or into the vault?”

choices.label: Hand it to Renn
choices.text: Hand the file to Renn.

choices.label: Keep it in Vale's vault
choices.text: Keep it in Vale's vault.

ignore.text: No decision was made; he took the silence as one.

yay_voss_sadakat.title: Vale opens the archive
yay_voss_sadakat.text: Remembering that you chose the courts, Vale duly handed over the file. “I have no copy, Your Majesty. This time.”

choices.label: Sign the receipt
choices.text: Sign the receipt.

choices.label: Close the file
choices.text: Close the file.

yay_voss_kopus.title: Vale's second archive
yay_voss_kopus.text: You had let him keep the file in the vault. Vale held out a slim folder. “The original is safe. You needn't know where—not yet.”

choices.label: Ask for the archive log
choices.text: Ask for the archive log.

choices.label: Keep an eye on him
choices.text: Keep an eye on him for now.

yay_kessler_yukselis.title: Veyra's ledger
yay_kessler_yukselis.text: Veyra has written a note in her own hand along the ledger's edge: “If every penny has a place, there's nothing to fear.” The ink on the last line is still wet.

choices.label: Show the ledger to the Assembly
choices.text: Show the ledger to the Assembly as well.

choices.label: Keep it at the Palace
choices.text: Keep it at the Palace for now.

yay_kessler_sinav.title: A missing budget line
yay_kessler_sinav.text: An unexplained item appears among the Treasury's expenses. Veyra whispers, “If I cover this line, we breathe easier today. Not tomorrow.”

choices.label: Record the shortfall
choices.text: Record the shortfall openly.

choices.label: Push it to next year
choices.text: Push the item into next year's budget.

ignore.text: No decision was made; she took the silence as one.

yay_kessler_sadakat.title: Veyra puts her name to it
yay_kessler_sadakat.text: You had let her disclose the shortfall. Veyra placed her trembling hand beside the signature. “The figures are heavy, but they are ours now.”

choices.label: Back the minister
choices.text: Stand behind the minister.

choices.label: Order an independent audit
choices.text: Ask for an independent audit.

yay_kessler_kopus.title: A blank line in the ledger
yay_kessler_kopus.text: You had asked her to hide the missing item. Veyra left the ledger open. “Your Majesty, the space I left blank grows a little every day.”

choices.label: Reopen the ledger
choices.text: Reopen the ledger.

choices.label: Tell her to stay quiet
choices.text: Ask her to stay quiet.

yay_halden_yukselis.title: Sarne's open mic
yay_halden_yukselis.text: Sarne opened the studio doors. “The screen is mine, the voice is yours. Tomorrow the whole country can hear you.” He smiled and held out the advertising ledger.

choices.label: Keep the broadcast open
choices.text: Keep the broadcast open.

choices.label: Hear the terms first
choices.text: Hear the terms first.

yay_halden_sinav.title: The price of airtime
yay_halden_sinav.text: He wants a tender story pulled from the broadcast. Sarne put a hand on your shoulder. “Just one evening of silence, Your Majesty. Then everyone wins.”

choices.label: Air the story
choices.text: Air the story.

choices.label: Silence it tonight
choices.text: Silence it tonight.

ignore.text: No decision was made; he took the silence as one.

yay_halden_sadakat.title: Sarne shows the contract
yay_halden_sadakat.text: You had left the story on air. Sarne spread the agreement across the table. “Open business, open books. I'll have to get used to this much honesty.”

choices.label: Publish the contract
choices.text: Publish the contract.

choices.label: Leave it on the table
choices.text: Leave it on the table.

yay_halden_kopus.title: Sarne cuts the broadcast
yay_halden_kopus.text: You let him pull the plug. Sarne slipped the remote into his pocket. “I protected you. One day, you'll remember which button I pressed.”

choices.label: Ask for the broadcast schedule
choices.text: Ask for the broadcast schedule.

choices.label: Accept the price
choices.text: Accept the price.

yay_lena_yukselis.title: Leyla's source ledger
yay_lena_yukselis.text: Leyla spent the night comparing documents. “Before I print this, I'll ask one more person. One mistake can burn the truth too.”

choices.label: Wait for the documents to be verified
choices.text: Wait for the documents to be verified.

choices.label: Ask for the story early
choices.text: Ask for the story early.

yay_lena_sinav.title: The source's name is demanded
yay_lena_sinav.text: Someone from the Palace wants Leyla's source. She kept hold of the file. “I'll discuss the story. I won't give you the name.”

choices.label: Protect the source
choices.text: Protect the source.

choices.label: Demand the name for the Palace
choices.text: Demand the name for the Palace.

ignore.text: No decision was made; they took it as silence.

yay_lena_sadakat.title: Leyla protects her source
yay_lena_sadakat.text: You did not pursue her source. Leyla nodded. “You don't have to trust me. Test what I write.”

choices.label: Give a straight answer
choices.text: Give a straight answer.

choices.label: Just keep watch
choices.text: Just keep watch.

yay_lena_kopus.title: Leyla closes the door
yay_lena_kopus.text: You asked for her source. As Leyla shut the door, she said, “Next time, answer what I publish, not me.”

choices.label: Send the press a right of reply
choices.text: Send the press a right of reply.

choices.label: Leave the door shut
choices.text: Leave the door shut.

yay_dorn_yukselis.title: Helena's appointment book
yay_dorn_yukselis.text: Helena brought the appointment book on a silver tray. “Your Majesty, everyone at the door thinks they're urgent. I only keep the queue in order.”

choices.label: Open the book to inspection
choices.text: Open the book to inspection.

choices.label: Leave it to Helena
choices.text: Leave it to Helena.

yay_dorn_sinav.title: The queue at the Palace gate
yay_dorn_sinav.text: Two delegations were booked for the same hour. Helena smiled faintly. “Who goes in first decides who matters more.”

choices.label: Publish the queue
choices.text: Publish the queue.

choices.label: Use the private entrance
choices.text: Use the private entrance.

ignore.text: No decision was made; they took it as silence.

yay_dorn_sadakat.title: Helena opens the book
yay_dorn_sadakat.text: You asked her to keep the queue public. Helena handed you the pen. “Today, the record—not I—opened the door.”

choices.label: Keep the minutes
choices.text: Keep the minutes.

choices.label: Write a new rule
choices.text: Write a new rule.

yay_dorn_kopus.title: Helena's private entrance
yay_dorn_kopus.text: You let her hide the queue. Helena smiled again. “The back door is still a Palace door, Your Majesty.”

choices.label: Count the doors again
choices.text: Count the doors again.

choices.label: Look the other way
choices.text: Look the other way.

yay_prens_yukselis.title: The Prince's empty chair
yay_prens_yukselis.text: Marcus saw there was no place set for him at the ceremony. “Our father would have set the same table. The crown went to you; my chair did not vanish.”

choices.label: Make room at the ceremony
choices.text: Make room at the ceremony.

choices.label: Leave the ceremony as it is
choices.text: Leave the ceremony as it is.

yay_prens_sinav.title: The seal at the family table
yay_prens_sinav.text: The dynasty's joint statement awaits a seal. Marcus pauses: “Am I signing as a brother—or as a shadow?”

choices.label: Sign the statement together
choices.text: Sign the statement together.

choices.label: Seal it alone
choices.text: Seal it alone.

ignore.text: No decision was made; he took the silence for an answer.

yay_prens_sadakat.title: The prince stands with you
yay_prens_sadakat.text: You had named him an equal member of the family in the statement. Marcus turned to the crowd: “I, too, will defend my brother's crown.”

choices.label: Accept his word
choices.text: Accept his word.

choices.label: Let him choose his own path
choices.text: Let him choose his own path.

yay_prens_kopus.title: The prince sets another table
yay_prens_kopus.text: You had denied him the seal. Marcus made no effort to hide his hurt: “There is a family table beyond your Palace, too.”

choices.label: Meet with the family
choices.text: Meet with the family.

choices.label: Leave some distance
choices.text: Leave some distance.

yay_brandt_yukselis.title: Voss in the neighborhoods
yay_brandt_yukselis.text: Voss spoke at the factory gate: “People shouldn't have to choose between bread and a ballot.” Then he listened to those who came, one by one.

choices.label: Hear the representatives
choices.text: Hear the representatives.

choices.label: Postpone the meeting
choices.text: Postpone the meeting.

yay_brandt_sinav.title: The square raises its voice
yay_brandt_sinav.text: An angry crowd filled the square. Voss brought his fist down: “If we don't make promises today, stones will speak tomorrow.”

choices.label: Call them to the table
choices.text: Call them to the table.

choices.label: Close the door
choices.text: Close the door.

ignore.text: No decision was made; he took the silence for an answer.

yay_brandt_sadakat.title: Voss points to the ballot box
yay_brandt_sadakat.text: He remembered your invitation to the table. In the square, Voss said, “We'll settle the score at the ballot box.” There were whistles amid the applause.

choices.label: Discuss the election calendar
choices.text: Discuss the election calendar.

choices.label: Make a note of his words
choices.text: Make a note of his words.

yay_brandt_kopus.title: Voss won't leave the square
yay_brandt_kopus.text: You had shut the doors. Voss spoke in anger: “A square will answer a Palace that refuses to listen.”

choices.label: Offer an open meeting
choices.text: Offer an open meeting.

choices.label: Watch the square from afar
choices.text: Watch the square from afar.

yay_falk_yukselis.title: Renn's statement of independence
yay_falk_yukselis.text: Renn read a brief statement: “The law is written for kings too. Anything else is no law at all.” The silence in the hall lasted longer than the applause.

choices.label: Enter the statement into the record
choices.text: Enter the statement into the record.

choices.label: Cut the ceremony short
choices.text: Cut the ceremony short.

yay_falk_sinav.title: The procedure for the Palace file
yay_falk_sinav.text: A file concerning the Palace landed before you. Renn straightened her robe: “I do not rule on its contents. First, I examine the procedure.”

choices.label: Leave the file to procedure
choices.text: Leave the file to procedure.

choices.label: Ask the Palace for its view
choices.text: Ask the Palace for its view.

ignore.text: No decision was made; she took the silence for an answer.

yay_falk_sadakat.title: Renn stays on the bench
yay_falk_sadakat.text: You had let her uphold procedure. Renn sealed the file: “This decision is neither yours nor mine. It belongs to the court.”

choices.label: Enforce the court's ruling
choices.text: Enforce the court's ruling.

choices.label: Wait for an appeal
choices.text: Wait for an appeal.

yay_falk_kopus.title: Renn is left alone
yay_falk_kopus.text: You interfered with procedure. Renn was left alone on the bench: “Even alone, a judge must write the ruling.”

choices.label: Hear the judge out
choices.text: You hear the judge out.

choices.label: Hold the file
choices.text: You hold the file.

rejim_guvenlikci_hesap.title: The command council's ultimatum
rejim_guvenlikci_hesap.text: The defense council requested a closed session. The paper left on the table says the army now speaks before the government. Whether Arden signed it or not, the officers await the Crown's reply.

choices.label: Hear them before the Assembly
choices.text: The ultimatum reached the open floor; officers and civilians alike heard it.

choices.label: Meet at headquarters
choices.text: The meeting ended quietly. Outside, everyone wrote their own minutes.

rejim_populist_hesap.title: The square closes in
rejim_populist_hesap.text: You listened to the square for years; now every neighborhood brings its own account. From the lectern, Voss called out: “Rule with answers, not applause.” The Palace gate is open, but the road is crowded.

choices.label: Admit the delegates
choices.text: The Palace gate opened; talks began, and the demands stayed on the table.

choices.label: Go to the square
choices.text: The King appeared. The square listened, then spoke louder.

rejim_patronajci_hesap.title: The price of appointments
rejim_patronajci_hesap.text: Helena's ledger lists those who received posts from you, one beside another. Each expects something in return. Helena smiled politely: “Your Majesty, this order did not arrange itself.”

choices.label: Review the appointments openly
choices.text: The favors were questioned; some friends left the hall early.

choices.label: Ask Helena to lower her voice
choices.text: Helena closed the doors; expectations remained open.

rejim_oligark_hesap.title: Capital circles the Assembly
rejim_oligark_hesap.text: Business leaders gathered at one table before the budget vote. Sarne's name is on the list; everyone tells a different story about who set the table. The deputies look to the Palace for a decision.

choices.label: Open the donation books
choices.text: The books opened; markets grew nervous, and deputies grew cautious.

choices.label: Bargain over the budget
choices.text: The budget may pass; the Assembly is discussing the price.

rejim_medya_hesap.title: Broadcasters withdraw their support
rejim_medya_hesap.text: The morning bulletins left the same gap: no mention of the King. Sarne's channel and the independent papers are silent for different reasons. The country reads the silence as news.

choices.label: Take questions on camera
choices.text: The questions went on air; some answers were not well received.

choices.label: Reply in writing
choices.text: The statement was published; your voice traveled only as far as paper.

rejim_istihbarat_hesap.title: The secret archive's ultimatum
rejim_istihbarat_hesap.text: Sealed envelopes appeared on the ministers' desks at once. Only the intelligence service knows what is inside. Vale is nowhere to be seen; the archive he built now speaks in his name.

choices.label: Send the files to Renn
choices.text: The seals were broken in court; the Palace saw its own file too.

choices.label: Keep the envelopes at the Palace
choices.text: The envelopes were hidden; their senders stayed where they were.

kasa_bos.title: Salaries go unpaid
kasa_bos.text: Veyra opened the payroll ledger: “We cannot wait another month, Your Majesty.” The barracks' share is on this page too.

choices.label: Borrow the money
choices.text: Veyra brought a loan agreement. The Treasury could breathe; the interest went into the ledger.

choices.label: Pay the army first
choices.text: The soldiers were paid. The other clerks joined the queue.

choices.label: Tighten the belt
choices.text: Appropriations were cut. The ledger closed; the corridors grumbled.

ignore.text: The pay queue broke up. Arden began asking questions.

kasa_fazla.title: An unexpected surplus
kasa_fazla.text: Veyra asked, “Who should receive the accumulated surplus?” She wrote no one's name in the ledger's margin.

choices.label: Invest in institutions
choices.text: Old files were cleared, and new clerks were hired.

choices.label: Set aside a share for the people
choices.text: The queue outside the bakery grew shorter.

choices.label: Set aside the Palace's share
choices.text: Veyra wrote a figure on the blank line; there is a copy of the ledger too.

ignore.text: Veyra kept the surplus in the Treasury.

maliye_cokus.title: The tax ledgers won't close
maliye_cokus.text: Veyra spread the files across the table: “The tax clerks cannot make the numbers add up. Give me more staff.”

choices.label: Build an expert team
choices.text: The new clerks worked until midnight.

choices.label: Ask Sarne for a short-term loan
choices.text: A cheque arrived. Veyra crossed out the creditor's name twice.

ignore.text: The incomplete tax ledgers piled up on the shelves.

adliye_cokus.title: The courts can no longer write rulings
adliye_cokus.text: Renn said, “As files wait, witnesses fall silent.” Case advocates have formed a queue in the corridor.

choices.label: Open posts for judges
choices.text: Renn reviewed the new names one by one.

choices.label: Choose priority cases
choices.text: A few cases moved. The rest stayed put.

ignore.text: The queue in the courthouse corridor grew longer.

idare_cokus.title: Provincial governors await the Palace
idare_cokus.text: Helena bowed politely. “The letter has gone out, Your Majesty. We cannot be sure it arrived.”

choices.label: Send inspectors
choices.text: The governors found the seals; Helena noted which one was missing.

choices.label: Give Helena authority
choices.text: The Queen's network began working in the Palace's place.

ordu_zayif_sinir.title: The border is unprepared
ordu_zayif_sinir.text: Gunfire rang out in a border village. Arden said, “Our units lack equipment. If you want orders carried out, say so.”

choices.label: Declare mobilization
choices.text: The units set out; the depots rushed the missing ammunition to them.

choices.label: Turn to diplomacy
choices.text: The embassies talked through the night. Arden kept the map open.

choices.label: Manage the news
choices.text: Sarne replayed footage from the border. The barracks were still waiting.

ignore.text: Anxiety replaced the silence at the border.

ordu_zayif_sinir_ikinci.title: A second border crisis: units are missing
ordu_zayif_sinir_ikinci.text: A neighboring state massed tanks along the border. Arden studied the lists. “On paper, we're at full strength. In the field, we're not.”

choices.label: Mobilize the units at hand
choices.text: The trains filled. Arden made no attempt to hide the shortages.

choices.label: Hold secret talks
choices.text: The border night passed in conversation; the squares heard nothing.

choices.label: Call a mediator
choices.text: The crisis quieted, but the barracks were not pleased.

ignore.text: Unprepared units waited at the border.

uzman_bakan.title: A new order in the Treasury books
uzman_bakan.text: Veyra said, “This time, the columns add up.” Tax files that had waited for years are being closed.

choices.label: Keep the gains in reserve
choices.text: Veyra kept the staff working overtime.

choices.label: Reward the clerks
choices.text: For the first time, faces brightened at the ministry.

ignore.text: The new order ran on its own.

sadik_komutan_sinav.title: The loyal commander faces a first test
sadik_komutan_sinav.text: Arden said, “My man follows orders, but he doesn't know this map.” The border exercise was cut short.

choices.label: Allow time for training
choices.text: The officers drilled again. Arden watched in silence.

choices.label: Narrow the assignment
choices.text: The command was reduced, and Arden entered it in the record.

liyakatli_savci.title: The prosecutor nears a Palace file
liyakatli_savci.text: Renn said, “The prosecutor you appointed is following only the evidence. I won't close the door either.”

choices.label: Leave the prosecutor alone
choices.text: Renn nodded for the first time. The file stayed open.

choices.label: Review the Palace records
choices.text: The records were corrected; Renn did not ask why.

ignore.text: The prosecutor followed the file alone.

kadro_ihaneti.title: The meritocratic queen chooses her own path
kadro_ihaneti.text: Helena said softly, “The business of state won't fit the Palace's calendar, Your Majesty.” The governors now call her first.

choices.label: Put her authority in writing
choices.text: Helena took the seal; its limits went on paper too.

choices.label: Summon her to court
choices.text: She smiled politely; the provincial offices' phones fell silent for a day.

ignore.text: Helena carried on as she saw fit.

kurum_sessiz_cokus.title: The state slows in silence
kurum_sessiz_cokus.text: Treasury and Palace correspondence piled up on the same desk. Veyra turned a page; Helena covered another file.

choices.label: Set up a joint audit
choices.text: For the first time, the two institutions opened the same ledger.

choices.label: Get the Palace moving first
choices.text: The letters left the Palace; the tax office kept waiting.

ignore.text: Each office waited to hear from the other.

vilayet_hesabi.title: The provinces call in their accounts
