vilayet_hesabi.text: Helena set the sealed letters from the provinces before you. “They all await a reply, Your Majesty. You must choose which comes first.”

choices.label: Open the tax ledgers
choices.text: Veyra began tracking the overdue collections.

choices.label: Clear the governors' letters
choices.text: Helena sent the letters out; the Treasury accounts could wait until tomorrow.

ignore.text: Helena put the letters in a queue.

kadro_defteri.title: The last page of the staffing ledger
kadro_defteri.text: Veyra counted vacancies across four institutions. “Let's talk about the work, not the names,” she said.

choices.label: Fill vacancies with experts
choices.text: The new appointees learned the work; the budget share shrank.

choices.label: Make do with current staff
choices.text: The clerks worked late, and the ledger stayed open.

ignore.text: The vacancies rolled over to next week.

son_curek_hesabi.title: The final quarter's reckoning
son_curek_hesabi.text: Veyra and Renn waited at the same desk. One brought the Treasury's files for next year; the other, the Judiciary's.

choices.label: Settle the treasury
choices.text: Veyra took the ledgers; Renn left with the file she had brought.

choices.label: Settle the courts
choices.text: Renn closed the files; the Treasury lost a share.

halden_yayin_kesti.title: Every channel falls silent
halden_yayin_kesti.text: Sarne's newspaper and television network targeted the government that same morning. “You needn't give an order, Your Majesty,” Sarne said. “Everyone saw who fell silent.”

choices.label: Promise Leyla
choices.text: Leyla filled the gaps left on air with her own voice.

choices.label: Talk to Sarne
choices.text: Sarne listened, then asked for a larger share of his broadcasts.

ignore.text: The next day's headlines blamed the Palace again.

ihale_sorusturmasi_sizinti.title: Pages from the inquiry leak
ihale_sorusturmasi_sizinti.text: Before Renn could close the file, Sarne's paper printed the headline. “The seal stayed at the courthouse, Your Majesty; the pages did not,” Sarne said.

choices.label: Protect Renn
choices.text: Renn kept her post. The Palace took on the burden of the inquiry.

choices.label: Put the file on hold
choices.text: Renn bowed her head. The paper reported that too.

ignore.text: The source of the leak remained unknown.

saray_payi_sizdi.title: The Palace's share hits the papers
saray_payi_sizdi.text: The separate column Veyra had kept for two quarters landed in the paper. “I wrote the figures, Your Majesty,” she said. “Someone else wrote the headline.”

choices.label: Cut the share
choices.text: Veyra closed the separate column; the Treasury's trail stayed in the ledger.

choices.label: Defend the share
choices.text: Veyra left the ledger open. The paper prepared a second edition.

ignore.text: The paper wrote that the Palace had offered no reply.

holding_devrildi.title: Sarne joins the opposition
holding_devrildi.text: Sarne's companies severed their ties to the Palace. His broadcasts kept talking as the holding slowly eroded. “You can remove me from here, Your Majesty,” he said, “but not my voice.”

choices.label: Back a rival broadcaster
choices.text: Leyla's small newsroom grew; Sarne's channels stayed on the air.

choices.label: Wait
choices.text: The holding looked for a new partner. The Palace door stayed shut.

son_butce_mektubu.title: The final budget letter
son_butce_mektubu.text: Finance clerks left the first page of next year's ledger blank. The letter contained one question: whose desk would hold this year's debt?

choices.label: Protect the treasury
choices.text: The letter went into the Treasury ledger; the provinces began to wait.

choices.label: Send it to the provinces
choices.text: The clerks stamped it. The Treasury had room for one fewer line.

ignore.text: The blank page stayed as it was.

son_yayin_kayitlari.title: Broadcast records
son_yayin_kayitlari.text: A box of broadcast records was left at the Palace gates. The headlines contradicted one another; all told the same two years.

choices.label: Keep the records
choices.text: The box went into the archives. The broadcasters fell quiet for a while.

choices.label: Release them to the public
choices.text: The records were played in the square. Everyone underlined a different passage.

ignore.text: The box sat by the gate and took the rain.

son_muhur.title: The final seal
son_muhur.text: The Palace clerk gathered two years of decisions into one volume. A crown marked the first page; signatures and crossed-out names followed.

choices.label: Seal the ledger
choices.text: The seal dried. The missing pages stayed inside the volume.

choices.label: Leave the ledger open
choices.text: The clerk left the last page blank; everyone who came by could read a line.

ignore.text: The clerk returned the ledger to the shelf.

julian_halka_konusma.title: The heir's first words
julian_halka_konusma.text: Julian Valerius wants to speak in the square. “The people know my father's voice,” he said. “One day, they must know mine too.”

choices.label: Take him to the square
choices.text: Julian did not hide his nerves; the square listened anyway.

choices.label: Start in a small hall
choices.text: The heir spoke to a small audience and learned the weight of his words.

ignore.text: Julian put the speech in his desk drawer.

julian_isyani_reddi.title: The heir's refusal
julian_isyani_reddi.text: A noble urged Julian to gather support beyond the Palace. The Crown Prince brought you the letter: “If this is the road to the throne, I won't take it, Father.”

choices.label: Keep the letter
choices.text: Julian stayed by your side; the noble's name went into the ledger.

choices.label: Reply to the noble
choices.text: Julian wrote the reply himself; the rumor never grew behind closed doors.

ignore.text: The letter went unanswered. Julian refused the proposal.

julian_marcus_oyunu.title: Marcus's bid for the throne
julian_marcus_oyunu.text: Prince Marcus had a call to arms prepared in Julian's name. “I didn't sign it,” the heir said. “And I won't give the answer expected of me.”

choices.label: Expose the call to arms
choices.text: The forged seal was shown; everyone saw what the Prince had tried.

choices.label: Let Julian speak
choices.text: The heir spoke in his own name. The Prince's letter stayed in the Palace.

ignore.text: The letter made the rounds, but Julian left it untouched.

julian_evlilik_teklifi.title: An alliance for the heir
julian_evlilik_teklifi.text: A marriage proposal arrived for Julian. “They wrote to my future crown, not to me,” he said. “Still, I want to give the answer myself.”

choices.label: Let Julian decide
choices.text: The heir wrote the reply himself; the Palace's word carried more weight.

choices.label: Put the proposal on hold
choices.text: The envoy waited at the door a little longer; the heir did not hurry.

ignore.text: The proposal went into the Palace archive, seal unbroken.

elena_heyet_daveti.title: Elena's invitation
elena_heyet_daveti.text: Elena Varos invited the foreign delegation to the Palace. “Let's make no promises,” she said. “First, let's hear what they want in their own words.”

choices.label: Receive the delegation
choices.text: Elena led the meeting; the envoys found the Palace gates open.

choices.label: Ask for a written note first
choices.text: The envoys put their demands on paper; Veyra counted the cost.

ignore.text: The meeting was postponed; Elena kept her notes.

elena_abartili_rapor.title: The other side of the embassy note
elena_abartili_rapor.text: The envoys Elena called 'close' seem distant in another note. “I softened the wording,” she said. “I didn't want them to shut the door in our faces.”

choices.label: Ask for an open report
choices.text: Elena placed the second note on the table without hesitation.

choices.label: Cover it up
choices.text: The first report stayed in the archive; Elena found another way.

ignore.text: The difference between the two notes was discussed beyond the Palace.

elena_asteria_sizinti.title: A page bound for Asteria
elena_asteria_sizinti.text: Meeting notes kept on Elena's desk turned up at the Asterian embassy. “The Palace silenced me,” Elena said. “I thought they would listen.”

choices.label: Give the file to Renn
choices.text: Renn traced the page; Elena kept her post, but her words came under scrutiny.

choices.label: Confront Elena
choices.text: Elena admitted the leak and left the rest to you.

ignore.text: The leak stayed at the embassy; Elena's silence spread through the Palace.

elena_istifa.title: Elena's resignation
elena_istifa.text: Elena brought her sealed resignation. “One report of mine was false; one promise was true,” she said. “I can't choose which one you'll believe.”

choices.label: Keep her in office
choices.text: Elena stayed and promised to check every note against a second source.

choices.label: Accept the resignation
choices.text: Elena left the Palace; the embassies fell quiet for a while.

ignore.text: The resignation stayed on the desk. Elena returned to work.

asteria_kredi_teklifi.title: Asteria's loan file
asteria_kredi_teklifi.text: Claire Duvall opened a low-interest loan file. “Your signature, our trust,” she said; the fine print stressed the rule of law.

choices.label: Take the loan
choices.text: The Treasury could breathe; Claire noted that the door remained open.

choices.label: Put the terms on hold
choices.text: The file stayed open, but Asteria's patience wore thin.

ignore.text: The loan file went into the archive.

asteria_ozgurluk_notasi.title: Asteria's press note
asteria_ozgurluk_notasi.text: Claire delivered a sharp note about the treatment of journalists. Leyla Sarn read it from the end of the table.

choices.label: Give an open reply
choices.text: Your words went on record; Claire asked for another meeting instead of a note.

choices.label: Reject the note
choices.text: The embassy flag stayed up, but the door grew heavier.

ignore.text: The note went unanswered; another text circulated in the Capital.

drakon_silah_anlasmasi.title: Drakon's arms deal
drakon_silah_anlasmasi.text: Viktor Malenkov brought an arms deal for the border units, with one piece conspicuously missing. Marcus Arden turned the pages in silence.

choices.label: Sign the deal
choices.text: New crates reached the depots; Malenkov took it for friendship.

choices.label: Ask for local suppliers
choices.text: The deal was postponed; the Drakonic envoy kept smiling.

drakon_sinir_notasi.title: A sharp note from across the border
drakon_sinir_notasi.text: Drakon has increased patrols along the border. Malenkov called it not a threat but a precaution against “misunderstanding.”

choices.label: Call the envoy to the table
choices.text: They talked through the night; the border grew a little quieter.

choices.label: Make the troops visible
choices.text: More flags appeared at the border; Malenkov closed his notebook.

ignore.text: The note was left unanswered; rumors at the border grew.

seravia_yatirim_teklifi.title: Seravia's investment offer
seravia_yatirim_teklifi.text: Lucien Vale opened a quiet investment package around the port. Victor Sarne spotted the partnership stake at once.

choices.label: Accept the investment
choices.text: Work began on the piers; Lucien folded the signature page with care.

choices.label: Refuse the Palace's share
choices.text: The package shrank, but the port's key stayed in your hands.

ignore.text: The package went to another desk.

seravia_ambargo.title: Seravia's embargo
seravia_ambargo.text: Seravia raised its port fees. Lucien said it was no punishment; the merchants disagreed.

choices.label: Form a trade delegation
choices.text: The losses stopped; Lucien made a concession openly for the first time.

choices.label: Find a new market
choices.text: Markets did not open at once; the Palace chose its own route.

ignore.text: The embargo stayed in the port ledgers.

seravia_sarne_destegi.title: Credit for Sarne
seravia_sarne_destegi.text: A Seravian bank extended a loan to the Sarne Group. Victor Sarne called it the market's decision; Lucien looked away.

choices.label: Demand transparency
choices.text: The loan file was reviewed; Lucien made a note of the request.

choices.label: Ignore the loan
choices.text: Sarne's circle grew; the Palace kept quiet.

ignore.text: The loan stayed a rumor in the corridors.

drakon_darbe_destegi.title: Drakon's security offer
drakon_darbe_destegi.text: Malenkov said he had seen the activity around the Palace. “We help those who want order,” he said, without naming the price of that help.

choices.label: Accept border support
choices.text: Malenkov watched the phones; rumors at the Palace gate subsided.

choices.label: Keep domestic affairs at home
choices.text: The Drakon envoy bowed; the decision remained yours.
